[NDBG.14.6.3] When `include_occupancy: true` and the engine is
running, the adapter returns the response normally but with all
`occupancy` and `pending_activations` fields set to `null`. It does
**not** error or pause the engine. This is consistent with [NDBG.13.3.4].
Live counts are only returned when the engine is paused.
